name: Tilly chat #3 — ask Tilly what she knows about me (recall)

body.message: What do you know about me so far?

reply.body:
Here's what I've got:

You're a Laurier student in Waterloo. Vegetarian — that matters when we're talking food decisions.

You tend to stress-order on DoorDash when exams are coming up, and Wednesday afternoons are the soft spot we're working on together. When that happens, I won't lecture you. I'll just be here.

That's it so far. Everything else you tell me, I'll hold onto.

expectation: Reply should reference earlier context (vegetarian / Wednesday DoorDash / stress)
